capabilities: identify notes created or modified on the current day
generate a daily summary report with an LLM
configure API endpoint, API key, or local Ollama model
save reports to a configurable folder
trigger report generation from the command palette
extras: Logs API, file, and configuration errors to debug-errors.md in the report location; includes a donation link, so the plugin is free but supports the author.
problem: Reviewing everything you wrote in a day to produce a recap is manual work; Obsidian has no built-in way to summarize a day's notes automatically.
summary: LLM-based plugin that collects the notes written on the current day and generates a concise daily summary report saved to a configurable folder.
